verdict.rationale: Better Stack is a SaaS observability and incident-management platform, so a telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never documents any opt-out control for telemetry or usage tracking. The evidence covers SSO, private status pages and the MCP server, but these are adjacent features, not an opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
